mechanism: Both drugs can cause nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances; oseltamivir is renally cleared and amphotericin B-induced renal dysfunction may increase oseltamivir accumulation.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and oseltamivir efficacy; adjust oseltamivir dosing if creatinine clearance declines; ensure adequate hydration and consider nephroprotective measures during amphotericin B therapy.
